additional_info.subject: ID0451541-DC/Si-D/CH-[Y2 / R3 312881977025] Unable to Charge CRM:02699000255
additional_info.body:
Hi Alex, good morning.
I apologise for the lack of proper response.
When we are not going forward with the authentication we only have 3 possible root causes:
EV -> most common
Also reported from EcoG
EcoG
CCS cable (most unlikely)
I can see that since 27th Sep, there has been no successfull charging sessions in DC2. And all of them are during SLAC, which is reported with Error 54 or Error 39. I send a CSV in attachment of all the sessions from 7 days ago.
From DC1 I can see that there was a one time occurrence only and will not focus on that. What I propose if the following:
Reboot the EcoG remotely and try again
If it doesn't work then we need to go on-site and trial replacing the EcoG KF11.
If it doesn't work, then I can only assume that it's a CCS cable issue on the PLC comms cable.
Let me know what you think, I can reboot the EcoG right now since nobody is charging but we should tell the customer he will see in his backend that the outlets went unavailable for 1min.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: AW: ID0451541-DC/Si-D/CH-[Y2 / R3 312881977025] Unable to Charge CRM:02699000255
additional_info.body:
Hi Francisco
Thanks a lot for your response. At the end, the customer doesn’t care if it’s related to SLAC or to the EcoG or if the EV is the “root cause” they want just to use the Charger without any issues.
This isn't the first time the customer has complained; in the past, it was always related to the DC2. We can try the KF11, but our technician won't be able to diagnose the cable as the cause. When the technicians are on site, the charger usually works without any problems...
True to the motto “spontaneous self-healing.”
I will inform the customer that we will be rebooting the KF11.
May I ask you to perform the reboot?
I will inform the customer that they should continue to monitor the situation and provide me with feedback on how the charger behaves after the reboot. If the customer reports another error, I will order KF11 and schedule an on-site intervention.

Hi Alex, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
I checked this charger proactively and found that DC2 never failed a session since I rebooted the EcoG:
The session in DC1 that failed, was not given enough time for the Authentication to go through, and right after they did the correct thing, please see the difference:
And the next session on the same outlet with the same EV:
So it takes around 15sec for everything to start working since plug-in + authentication provided.
In this case, the customer plugged out before the session could even start.
I will keep this ticket for the next couple of days and if I don't see any problem again, we can close it, what do you think?
Thanks for the patience so far.
Best regards,
Francisco
